entries.275592c3f48fa7bd: This is product sales of fresh human hepatocytes collected by perfusion from PXB mice and supplied without freezing. Related products PXB-Shizuku, PXB-cells RF and PXB-cells Cryo have also been introduced to the market. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.637e4604d69e6418: This business uses the PXB mouse, a human hepatocyte chimeric mouse whose liver is more than 70% replaced with human hepatocytes, to provide contract testing services in the preclinical stage of drug development, and sells PXB mice and fresh human hepatocytes obtained from PXB mice. It is the single segment of the group, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,565 million. The head office (Higashihiroshima City, Hiroshima Prefecture) has PXB mouse production and research and development facilities, the consolidated subsidiary PhoenixBio USA Corporation handles overseas sales of PXB mice, and CMHL Consortium LLC manages research on the usefulness of PXB mice conducted jointly with pharmaceutical companies.
entries.a83a405049241b73: A company that uses "PXB mice," mice with human liver cells, to provide services such as contract testing that supports drug development by pharmaceutical companies.
entries.a861532890e1cfce: This is a contract testing service that uses PXB mice to evaluate and analyze the in vivo kinetics of drug candidates, and to evaluate and analyze toxicity to tissues and cells, starting with the liver. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.f9a82a51ef3501dc: This is a contract testing service that uses PXB mice in research on hepatitis B and hepatitis C viruses, which infect only human hepatocytes, and mainly evaluates the efficacy of anti-hepatitis drugs. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
